## Overview

Daiichi Sankyo is identified in the supplied sources as the funder of the two [edoxaban](./edoxaban.md) trials: ENGAGE AF-TIMI 48 was funded by Daiichi Sankyo Pharma Development and ELDERCARE-AF was funded by Daiichi Sankyo ([src_1bcbd58b429315ec591b7e167517461a](viking://user/ulab0001/resources/p/pmed01/sources/src_1bcbd58b429315ec591b7e167517461a.md), [src_0e9d75e95b4aa172897de8e3f4333228](viking://user/ulab0001/resources/p/pmed01/sources/src_0e9d75e95b4aa172897de8e3f4333228.md)).
